  <div class="bio-content">
    <p>I am a PhD candidate in the Evolutionary and Synthetic Biology Unit at the <a href="https://www.oist.jp/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST)</a>. My research explores molecular evolution and the evolutionary and artificial exploration of protein sequence space. I study protein fitness landscapes by combining genetic data with data-driven and physics-based models.</p>

    <p>My earlier work focused on protein dynamics and allostery, including elastic-network models of the SARS-CoV-2 main protease. I also teach practical, reproducible computing practices for researchers through the <a href="teaching.html">Good Enough Computing in Science</a> course.</p>

    <p>When away from the cluster and bench, I enjoy exploring books, music, and cinema—curated on <a href="personal.html">Personal</a>.</p>
